label: Oct 2026

route_caps.title: Routes against their planning cap
route_caps.serves: TfL CLP guidance: estimated vehicle movements, kept within what was agreed
route_caps.headline: 1 route over its cap
route_caps.subtitle: two-way movements a day, Oct 2026
route_caps.basis: Two-way movements a day: one load = one movement; the month's approved loads ÷ 22 working days, against the cap typed on the route. A flag, never a block. The Look-ahead's ROUTE CAP flag compares the same cap with the lorries needed on a day; this chart, like the bulletin, compares it with movements a day.
route_caps.source: Wayscope: the approved plan and each route's typed cap

site_caps.title: Sites against their CLP cap
site_caps.serves: TfL CLP guidance: the peak number of vehicles a site can take
site_caps.headline: 1 site over its CLP cap
site_caps.subtitle: lorry visits a day, Oct 2026
site_caps.basis: A visit is one lorry in and out: a delivery where the site is the destination, or a lorry coming to load where it is the origin; the month's approved trips ÷ 22 working days, every team together, against the CLP cap typed on the location. A flag, never a block.
site_caps.source: Wayscope: the approved plan and each site's typed CLP cap

vehicle_types.title: Movements by vehicle type
vehicle_types.serves: TfL CLP guidance: vehicle movements by type and size
vehicle_types.headline: Artic Tipper (44t) carries 63 % of the loads
vehicle_types.subtitle: share of approved loads each month (one load = one movement)
vehicle_types.basis: Approved loads (trips, rounded up per forecast month) by the vehicle each line plans to use.
vehicle_types.source: Wayscope: the approved plan; vehicle types from Config → Vehicles

euro_class.title: Movements by Euro class
euro_class.serves: TfL CLP guidance: vehicle age and emissions standard
euro_class.headline: Euro VI: 63 % of the loads
euro_class.subtitle: share of approved loads each month, by the Euro class typed for each vehicle type
euro_class.basis: The Euro class the plan assumes for each vehicle type (Config → Vehicles), not a check of any haulier's fleet. A vehicle type with none typed is counted as Not typed, never guessed.
euro_class.source: Wayscope: the approved plan; Euro classes typed on Config → Vehicles

councils.title: Movements and lorry distance by council
councils.serves: TfL CLP guidance: routes and the roads the scheme's lorries use
councils.headline: Westshire takes the most: 9.1 movements a day
councils.subtitle: lorry-km in Oct 2026, laden and empty, and two-way movements a day
councils.basis: Two-way movements a day: one load = one two-way movement. An area counts the month's approved loads of every route whose laden leg enters it, divided by the working days; the empty return adds none. A route counts in every area its laden leg enters, so the areas' figures add up to more than the scheme's. A laden leg enters an area when at least 200 m of it is inside (the boundaries are generalised to 200 m); a route inside by less adds its km and carbon there, not its movements. Distance: every lorry-km driven inside the area, laden and empty.
councils.double_count: A route counts in every area its laden leg enters, so the areas' figures add up to more than the scheme's.

carbon_rate.title: Carbon per delivery and per tonne against the target
carbon_rate.headline: 8.61 kg CO₂e a tonne planned; the target allows 8.42
carbon_rate.per_load_note: Per load has no target line: a decision that moves material to a bigger lorry makes fewer, heavier loads, so the carbon a load can rise while the total falls.
carbon_rate.subtitle: kg CO₂e per load and per tonne, all-in (making the material, transport and waste disposal)
carbon_rate.basis: All-in carbon of the approved plan each month ÷ its loads and ÷ its tonnes; with the agreed decisions where a target is set. The target line is the carbon target shared out evenly over the tonnes: the target ÷ the whole plan's tonnes. Per load has no target line: a decision that moves material to a bigger lorry makes fewer, heavier loads, so the carbon a load can rise while the total falls. 1 forecast month with no road route yet carries no transport carbon here.
carbon_rate.source: Wayscope Carbon planner: DESNZ 2026 conversion factors and the factors it names; the target set on the Carbon planner

trips_avoided.title: Lorry trips avoided by the agreed decisions
trips_avoided.serves: TfL CLP guidance: measures that reduce vehicle trips
decisions: Vehicle choice: Artic Tipper (44t) — route R002: Pit North → Yard North
trips_avoided.headline: 31 lorry trips avoided
trips_avoided.subtitle: approved loads each month, as planned and with the agreed decisions
trips_avoided.basis: Loads as planned against the same plan with the decisions agreed with the carbon target (a bigger lorry, a nearer supplier, another route). A decision that changes only the material changes no trips. Planned, not observed.
trips_avoided.source: Wayscope Carbon planner: the decisions stored with the carbon target

peak_words: No deliveries 07:00–10:00 and 16:00–19:00 (the CLP's peak bands, taken off each gate's open hours where they are typed).
limit: Planned figures, not observed: Wayscope holds no gate log or arrival times.
